description: This Java source file defines the LogFragment class, a Fragment subclass that contains a LogView and a ScrollView, used for displaying log data within an Android application. It includes methods for inflating views, setting up the log display, and handling text changes to auto-scroll.

classes.name: LogFragment
classes.description: A Fragment subclass that manages a LogView inside a ScrollView for displaying logs.

methods.name: inflateViews
methods.description: Creates and configures the ScrollView and LogView, setting layout parameters, styles, and padding.

methods.name: onCreateView
methods.description: Inflates the view hierarchy, sets up a TextWatcher to auto-scroll on text change, and returns the root view.

methods.name: getLogView
methods.description: Returns the LogView instance managed by this fragment.
